title: cordon.checks.json
description: Per-repo configuration for cordon's checks engine — and usually the whole file is optional. Checks auto-detect from the repo's stack; the common case is no file at all. Reach for one only to deviate: `enable`/`disable` flip a check by name (the bare minimum), a check-id key tunes a built-in check's options, and `commands` adds a repo's own spawned specs. Run `node checks/run.ts --list` to see exactly what runs here.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

enable.description: Turn ON a check that is off by default here — an opt-in check declared `default: 'off'`. Names only; everything else (effect, command, fix) is cordon's. Run `node checks/run.ts --list` to see what applies.

disable.description: Turn OFF an auto-detected check by id (e.g. `pip-audit`, or a discovered `check:*` script). The bare-minimum way to drop a check: just its name, no other config.

commands.description: Escape hatch for a repo-specific spawned spec cordon's catalog doesn't already cover. Most repos need none — language presets auto-detect (uv/cordon-tool/shell) and package.json `check:*` scripts are discovered. Reach for this only for a genuinely bespoke check; declare its blast-radius `effect`. An id here overrides a catalog check of the same id.

id.description: Stable id (verdict key, --only target). Unique across built-in checks too.

name.description: Human title for the verdict; defaults to id.

effect.description: Blast radius an agent risk-gates on (cordon's ladder). Required — an unclassified spec must never run as a safe read.

network.description: Set only when the spec itself reaches off-box.

interactive.description: Set only when the spec blocks on a TTY.

requires.description: Capabilities it needs (git/macos/ci, file:<path>, glob:<pattern>, <binary>, or !cap to negate); the engine skips it fail-soft when unmet.

phase.description: Where it runs around the repo's own build step (pre-build → build → post-build). Default pre-build.

default.description: Set to 'off' to make this an opt-in check — it runs only when its id is in `enable`. Omit for the normal on-when-detected behavior.

timeout.description: Kill the spec after this many ms rather than wedge the gate.

exec.description: The process to spawn from the repo root.

env.description: Extra env, merged over the process env.

fixExec.description: The autofix seam: the repair to spawn when this check fails under --fix. The engine runs it, then re-runs the check — only a green re-run reports 'fixed'. Omit when the failure has no mechanical repair.

env.description: Extra env, merged over the process env.

repository-policy.description: Repo hygiene: no tracked secrets/build output/conflict copies, unambiguous modules, pinned Actions. Universal rules need no config; the keys below tune the stack-specific ones.

forbiddenDirs.description: Directories whose tracked contents are always build output, never source.

conflictScanDirs.description: Extra trees to walk for untracked conflict copies ("name 2.ext", left by Finder or iCloud). Tracked copies are caught regardless; [] walks nothing.

checkNvmrc.description: When a .nvmrc is present, require the running Node major.minor to match it.

checkLockfile.description: When package.json and package-lock.json are both present, require their name/version/dependencies to agree.

allowTaggedActions.description: Accept tag/branch GitHub Action pins (e.g. @v5). Set false to enforce full commit-SHA pins (the hardened house policy).

idempotence.description: Run a build/verify command and assert it leaves the worktree byte-identical. Off until you set a command.

command.description: Shell command whose run must not change tracked or untracked files, e.g. "npm run build". null skips the check — set this to turn it on.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the command after this many milliseconds rather than wedge the gate.

dispatch-dups.description: Config for the "CLI Dispatch Duplicates" check — no options.

bats-assertions.description: Config for the "Bats Assertion Chaining" check — no options.

ruff.description: Config for the "Ruff lint" check — no options.

pythonVersions.description: Python versions to run the suite across (e.g. ["3.11","3.12"]), as one check via `uv run --python <v>`. Omit to auto-derive from pyproject [project].classifiers; set [] to force a single default run.

version-alignment.description: Config for the "Version alignment" check — no options.

package-smoke.description: Config for the "Built package imports" check — no options.

conformance.description: Config for the "Contracts validate against cordon" check — no options.

drift.description: Config for the "Contract matches live --describe" check — no options.

readme-sync.description: Config for the "README reference in sync" check — no options.

shellcheck.description: Config for the "ShellCheck" check — no options.

bats.description: Config for the "Bats tests" check — no options.
